scope: New and SHA256-modified allowlisted research files relative to the combined two-pilot checkpoint
restore_semantics: Extract both base archives, then concatenate chunks in recorded order, verify archive SHA256, and extract overlay. Absent baseline paths are recorded, not deleted automatically.

qlp-pilot.limitation: Cached QLP light curves checked; only previously recorded sector-1/2 pixel data are included. No tests rerun.

qlp-overlapfield-pilot.limitation: Cached QLP light curves checked; only previously recorded sector-1/2 pixel data are included. No tests rerun.

verification: Every member size/SHA256 and included source checked; concatenated chunks match full archive size/SHA256; preexisting checkpoints unchanged.
limitations: No secrets, virtual environment or Git history included. Cache scientific artifacts remain eligible.
SHA256 verifies byte identity, not scientific novelty.
